summary: Iteration 6 business model tested end-to-end. Backend: 29/29 pytest pass (kit sizes, quote examples A/B/C = 299/419/574, capacity 422 on quote and POST /kits, public product field hiding, HOSPITAL-DEMO validate/activate once, FUNDACION-2024 vencido, /me/plan plus|free, checkout quote best-stacking 15% (86) + credit 150 + shipping 99 = 437, order 'Pendiente de confirmación' reserves stock and consumes credit, agotado p13 -> 409, big credit -> items_total 0/total 99, admin Enviado decrements stock+reserved, cancel releases reservation, closed order -> 400, caregiver 403 on 9 admin endpoints, costing 180/119/39.8, product PUT + validation, inventory entrada/salida/ajuste, suppliers, settings round-trip). Frontend (390px + 360px): kit-builder 5 steps all OK (Desde $299/$499/$799, Otro input, tags INCLUIDO/PREMIUM +$/NO DISPONIBLE, live total 419->484->484->574, capacity toast, summary with Por calcular, save -> /kit/<id>, order -> /cart $419), kit detail Incluido/+$ lines and duplicate OK, plan/redeem flow OK (expired error, info, activate -> Plus Institucional + 3 benefits), plan-change Plus/Gratis demo OK, checkout breakdown + demo notice + order detail + cancel + repeat OK, admin index/products/inventory/costing (live)/suppliers/codes/orders chips/settings OK, caregiver sees 'Sin acceso'. Bugs: (1) code sheet Save button unreachable (Sheet not scrollable); (2) cancelled orders do not refund institutional credit; (3) admin overview counts legacy orders without status as open / revenue; (4) order screen says '¡Pedido confirmado!' while status is Pendiente de confirmación. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

critical.issue: set_order_status releases stock reservation but never refunds the institutional credit consumed at checkout. Reproduced: user with $150 credit placed order (credit 150 used), cancelled -> /me/plan credit remaining stays 0. business.py:325-339 (credit is decremented in place_order 305-311 but not restored).

minor.issue: orders_open/revenue_demo use raw o.get('status'); legacy orders without 'status' (some cancelled via 'cancelled': true) are counted as open and their totals included in revenue (UI showed 'Pedidos abiertos 11 de 13' while list shows most Cancelado; revenue $21,950). Use order_view()-derived status. business.py:405-409. Same: GET /api/admin/orders returns raw docs (status null for legacy orders).
available = stock > 0 ignores stock_reserved, whereas price_kit/place_order use stock - stock_reserved. An item fully reserved shows available in catalog but 409s at checkout. business.py:68
No type/range validation (stacking can be any string, negative pct, non-numeric values accepted). business.py:505-507
No delete endpoint; test codes can only be paused (TEST-UICODE and TEST-xxxx codes left 'pausado').

ui_bugs.issue: Sheet (src/ui.tsx:432-448, maxHeight 85%, no ScrollView) clips content; at 390x844 the Save button sits at y=1000, cannot be scrolled to or tapped (Playwright: 'Element is outside of the viewport', mouse wheel does nothing). Only JS click worked. Wrap Sheet children in a ScrollView (keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled') or add ScrollView in app/admin/codes.tsx:48.
New order shows '¡Pedido confirmado!' while status badge says 'Pendiente de confirmación' (contradictory). app/order/[id].tsx:41
order-cancel-button cancels immediately with no confirmation sheet (destructive action). app/order/[id].tsx:113

integration_issues.issue: After cancelling, plan screen still shows credit used ($0 de $150) because backend doesn't refund it.

issues: Code validity shows 'vie 31 dic' / admin new code 'Hoy – sáb 20 nov' (actually next year) without year; ambiguous, looks like it expires this year/today.
When a context with tags is chosen, the first chip is 'Sugeridos' and there is no 'Todo' option to see the full catalog at once (only per-category).

action_items: HIGH: Make Sheet content scrollable (src/ui.tsx Sheet -> ScrollView inside) so admin-code-save (and other tall sheets) is reachable on 390x844 and smaller.
HIGH: Refund consumed institutional credit when an order is cancelled (store per-benefit credit usage on the order and $inc remaining back in set_order_status).
MEDIUM: Change order confirmation copy for 'Pendiente de confirmación' (e.g., '¡Pedido registrado!').
MEDIUM: admin_overview/admin_orders should derive status via order_view() for legacy orders (open count & revenue).
LOW: public_product.available should use stock - stock_reserved; validate settings costs/plans types; add confirm before cancelling an order; show year in validity dates.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1341 lines (>700) - split into routers.
Credit consumption in place_order is non-atomic read-then-$inc; concurrent checkouts may overspend credit (use conditional update remaining >= use).
Stock reservation check in place_order is read-then-$inc without condition; concurrent orders can over-reserve.
kit/[id].tsx duplicate handler has no try/catch / error toast.

success_rate.backend: 100% (29/29 tests); 1 HIGH logic bug found by exploration (credit refund)
success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all requested flows work; code-sheet save unreachable)

Kit builder steps animate: wait for kit-builder-step-N before clicking. Choose context 'Otro' to see 'Todo' filter with all products. rca_of_issue: Code sheet: Sheet View has maxHeight 85% with children rendered directly (no ScrollView) so overflow is clipped. Credit: place_order decrements benefits.remaining but set_order_status(Cancelado) only reverts stock_reserved.
